title: Veo image-to-video accepts a starting frame
summary:
Veo gained a usable starting frame, subscriptions lost a manual step, and Hello's playground got a single API route.

Veo image-to-video requests now pass the supplied image as the video's reference first frame. When a request includes multiple images, it uses the first.

New accounts are assigned the SPORE subscription automatically, replacing Enter's manual activation button. Tier syncing also handles canceled subscriptions, while the pricing page clarifies that its Pollen estimate uses a seven-day community average.

Hello's playground, examples, generation requests, and model lists now use a same-origin `/api` route. A follow-up moved that proxy to a Cloudflare Worker while leaving other requests to the static site.
